compounds.name: ethyl butanoate

ammonia.reason: Long proteolysis releases NH3 by deamination but low Aw limits urease activity.

animal_barnyard.reason: Low p-cresol/indole from cow milk and whey starter; no manure taint.

bitter.reason: Accumulation of hydrophobic casein peptides from rennet and plasmin proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; methyl ketones only at background lipolysis levels.

browning.reason: Low moisture plus free amino acids and residual galactose drive Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Lactobacillus citrate metabolism largely volatilized during long aging.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate lipolysis by native lipase releases butanoic and hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: Low moisture 35% and dense cooked-pressed protein matrix limit fat lubrication.

crumbliness.reason: Extensive proteolysis plus tyrosine crystals create granular fracture in cooked hard paste.

firmness.reason: Cooked to 53-56C, pressed and aged 9-16mo with 35% moisture gives very hard body.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol by lactobacilli.

fruity.reason: Esterification forms ethyl butanoate 124-362 ug/kg and ethyl hexanoate during aging.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks high 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic branched acids of goat.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker degradation of leucine/isoleucine to 2-/3-methylbutanal and pyrazines.

melt.reason: Low moisture, pH 5.4 and highly crosslinked paracasein restrict flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Low 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleic oxidation; no surface mold geosmin.

oil_off.reason: 27.5% fat in contracted protein matrix releases moderate free oil when heated.

smoky.reason: No smoke application; no guaiacol/syringol phenols formed.

sour_vinegar.reason: Natural whey culture ferments lactose to lactic with some acetic to pH ~5.4.

stretch.reason: Rennet-cooked curd not pasta-filata; no aligned micelle fibers for stretching.

sulfur_cooked.reason: High curd cook plus methionine catabolism to methanethiol, DMS and H2S.

sweet.reason: Free amino acids, glycerol and low salt 1.52% give mild sweet balance.

umami.reason: Intense secondary proteolysis releases abundant glutamate and savory peptides.
